description: Build a dependency/relationship graph starting from a seed issue. Returns a map of connected issues (parent/child hierarchy, blocks, relates to, duplicates, etc.) with nodes and edges, plus a Mermaid diagram for visualization. Use this to understand how issues are connected across epics, stories, and subtasks.

direction.description: Which link directions to follow: "all", "inward", or "outward" (default: "all")

issueKey.description: Seed issue key to start graph traversal from (e.g., PROJECT-123)

linkTypes.description: Filter to specific link types (e.g., ["Blocks", "Relates"]). If omitted, includes all link types.

maxDepth.description: Maximum BFS traversal depth from seed issue (default: 2, max: 5)

maxNodes.description: Maximum number of nodes to include in the graph (default: 50, max: 200)

name: jira_get_issue_graph
